claims.text: Signed the TTSA CRADA on 10 October 2019 as Director of the Army Ground Vehicle Systems Center.

The Army's own announcement records that Langhout 'served in a variety of leadership roles at AvMC from April 2013 to October 2018, when he became the director of the DEVCOM Ground Vehicle Systems Center in Warren, Michigan' (the article prints his surname as 'Langout' at that point), and that he 'assumed the duties of DEVCOM Aviation & Missile Center director Jan. 17' 2021.
